name: Sredno Vodno – Millennium Cross
shortDescription: The standard out-and-back climb from Sredno Vodno to the Millennium Cross on Krstovar.
description: This popular Skopje route starts at the Sredno Vodno cable-car station and climbs on signed forest paths toward Krstovar (1,066 m), the summit crowned by the Millennium Cross. The upper slopes open to broad views across Skopje and the surrounding mountains. Several path variants exist, so the recorded distance represents the main round trip.

name: Matka Canyon – St. Nicholas Šiševski Monastery
shortDescription: A short, steep canyon hike from Matka to St. Nicholas Šiševski Monastery.
description: From the bridge and kayaking area at Matka, the footpath climbs above the Treska reservoir to the medieval St. Nicholas Šiševski Monastery on Vodno's western slope. The monastery stands roughly 160 metres above the lake and is inaccessible by road. The path is rocky and can be slippery after rain; this is a different outing from the mostly level path that follows the reservoir shoreline.

name: Ljuboten Mountain Hut – Ljuboten Peak
shortDescription: A demanding ascent from the historic Ljuboten hut to the mountain's distinctive border summit.
description: From Mountain Hut Ljuboten above Staro Selo, the route leaves the forest belt and climbs through pasture toward the prominent pyramidal summit of Ljuboten (2,498 m). The upper section is exposed and the summit lies on the Kosovo border, so hikers should carry offline navigation and check current border guidance. The hut is also the northern gateway of the High Scardus Trail.

name: Popova Šapka – Titov Vrv
shortDescription: The classic long route from Popova Šapka to Titov Vrv, the highest summit of Šar Mountain.
description: The marked route begins at Popova Šapka and crosses open high-mountain terrain via the Ceripašina and Bakardan area before the final climb to Titov Vrv (2,747 m). A stone tower marks the summit, with views toward the Pena headwaters and Šar Mountain's glacial lakes. The route is long, exposed and vulnerable to rapid weather changes; reliable navigation and strong fitness are essential.

name: Strezimir (Pobeda) – Golem Korab
shortDescription: The standard ascent from the former Pobeda watchtower near Strezimir to Golem Korab.
description: This remote route starts near the former Pobeda border watchtower above Strezimir and climbs broad pasture, mountain streams and rocky upper slopes to Golem Korab (2,764 m), the highest point of North Macedonia and Albania. The summit follows the international border, access roads can be rough, and cloud makes navigation difficult. Hikers should check current access requirements before departure and carry sufficient water and offline mapping.

name: Galičica Pass – Magaro Peak
shortDescription: The national park's classic circuit from Galičica Pass to Magaro Peak.
description: Starting beside regional road P-504 at Galičica Pass, this signed circuit climbs through limestone grassland to Magaro (2,255 m), the highest summit in the national park. In clear weather the ridge gives simultaneous views of Lake Ohrid and Lake Prespa. The terrain is exposed with little shade or water, and summer hikers should start early.

name: Pelister Info Center – Pelister Peak via Bolnici
shortDescription: The official one-way ascent from the Pelister Info Center to Pelister Peak via Bolnici.
description: The park's official Bolnici route begins at the Information Center at 7 Kladenci, passes Hotel Molika and Kopanki, then crosses the distinctive stone field known as Bolnici before reaching Pelister Peak (2,601 m). It moves from molika pine forest into exposed alpine terrain and opens views over Pelagonia, Prespa and the Baba massif. The published 11 km and 4.5–5 hour figures are one way; plan additional time and distance for the return.

name: Adžibarica – Zelen Breg
shortDescription: The customary round trip from Adžibarica above Smrdliva Voda to Kožuf's highest summit.
description: The route begins in the Adžibarica area above Smrdliva Voda and climbs toward Zelen Breg (about 2,170 m), the rounded highest summit of Kožuf. Forest and high pasture give way to wide southern views toward the sharper Kožuf ridges and the Thessaloniki plain. The tourism authority estimates about six hours for the return hike; the area is remote and hikers should carry navigation and water.

name: Jakupica - Solunska Glava
shortDescription: A serious mountain day to the commanding summit of Solunska Glava.
description: The route traverses forest, karst plateau and exposed high ground on the way to one of central North Macedonia's finest viewpoints.

name: Popova Šapka – Gorna Lešnica – Lešnica
shortDescription: A marked traverse from Popova Šapka through Gorna Lešnica to the Lešnica valley.
description: Beginning at the information board in central Popova Šapka, the marked trail passes above the Jelak hut, crosses pasture near Ceripašinsko Bačilo and Plat, then descends through Gorna Lešnica into the canyon and valley of Lešnica. The route combines open views of Šar Mountain's central peaks with forest, streams and the Gorna Lešnica waterfall. Water is usually available along the route, but the return climb from the valley must be included in planning.

name: Nikiforovo – Sandaktaš Peak
shortDescription: A marked Bistra Mountain ascent from Nikiforovo to Sandaktaš Peak.
description: The route starts in Nikiforovo beside Mavrovo Lake, follows the Petilepska River through forest to the Petti Leb spring, then continues across open pasture to Sandaktaš (about 1,980 m). It is an established Mavrovo National Park trail tied to local St. Panteleimon traditions. The upper pasture is exposed and requires careful sign-following in fog; fill water at the village or Petti Leb.

name: Prilep – Treskavec Monastery
shortDescription: The marked one-way climb from Prilep's northern edge to Treskavec Monastery.
description: The trail climbs from above Prilep through the granite landscape below Markovi Kuli and Zlatovrv to the 12th-century Treskavec Monastery. It offers extensive views over the Pelagonia plain and passes striking boulders and exposed slabs. The published 6.7 km figure is one way; a short fixed rope assists one steeper rock section, and smooth granite becomes hazardous in rain or snow.

name: Krushevo - Mechkin Kamen
shortDescription: A forested heritage walk from Krushevo to Mechkin Kamen.
description: A pleasant highland route mixing pine and beech forest with historic monuments and open views around Krushevo.

name: Kokino Observatory Trail
shortDescription: A short volcanic-rock walk to the Kokino archaeological observatory.
description: This compact route explores the rugged summit of Tatikjev Kamen and the Bronze Age archaeological site at Kokino.

name: Ohrid Viewpoint Trail
shortDescription: A hillside route above Ohrid with lake, old town and mountain views.
description: Starting near the old town, this walk climbs through woodland and open slopes to a sequence of viewpoints over Lake Ohrid.

name: Smolare Waterfall Trail
shortDescription: A shaded woodland climb to North Macedonia's highest permanent waterfall.
description: Stone steps and a forest path follow the Lomnica stream to the 39-metre Smolare Waterfall on Belasica.

name: Berovo Lake Loop
shortDescription: A gentle circuit through pine forest around Berovo Lake.
description: A calm lower-mountain loop suited to relaxed walking, with forest shade, lakeside sections and picnic stops.

name: Babuna - Nezhilovo to Cheples
shortDescription: A steady forest ascent from Nezhilovo to the Cheples mountain hut.
description: A classic central mountain approach through dense forest, with streams and clearings beneath the Jakupica massif.

name: Demir Kapija Canyon Trail
shortDescription: A warm, rocky canyon route above the Vardar at Demir Kapija.
description: A limestone trail with dry Mediterranean vegetation, birdlife and dramatic views into the Demir Kapija gorge.

name: Plachkovica - Lisec Peak
shortDescription: A forest-to-ridge ascent of Lisec, the highest point of Plachkovica.
description: A varied eastern mountain route through beech forest and open summit terrain with broad views toward Osogovo and Belasica.
